engineering_geometry_policy.note: Lateral/overlap/perimeter are declared trial policies, not physical laws. Explicit lateral/overlap values permit a bounded contact experiment, not a material-feasibility claim. The initial COM search radius does not change the 30 mm individual or 50 mm cumulative correction budget. The 5 mm minimum teddy/left-robot clearance is an engineering preflight allowance, not a physical law. Bottom clearance and lateral trial fraction are configurable; no compression is prescribed.

limitations: This counterfactual rotation does not model the actual mirrored upper-arm grasp, settling, shape changes, inertia or frictional retention.
Frozen vertical teddy sweep versus all22 measured left collision geoms is certified only where clear; horizontal approach, right robot IK/rigid routes and future left cloth motion are not checked.
Rim perimeter and section overlap are finite engineering trial screens, not proof of nonplanar deformable passage or final bag containment.
Some requested offsets exceed the existing35mm initial COM radius and are explicitly marked; no runtime configuration was changed.
A different actual grasp layout requires a fresh physical prefix and repeated actual-shape/force/torque/grasp/deformation checks.
conclusion: No 5 mm-certified frozen vertical channel among these 9 positions. All six candidates with X offset 0 or 12 mm have verified intersections with the original left-hand collision solid. The three X=24 mm points fail the conservative 5 mm clearance certificate and also have section overlap below 40%; this does not prove all other layouts impossible.
